name: weekday_offset
description: Name the weekday k days after a given day; matched number-offset control. Tests weekday calendar/name support, not by itself an arithmetic-specific circuit.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
days=['Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday','Sunday']
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(112):
 d=random.randrange(7); k=random.randrange(1,29); n=random.randrange(1,60)
 items.append({'prompt':f'The starting weekday is {days[d]}. Advance by {k} days. The resulting weekday is','answer':' '+days[(d+k)%7]})
 control.append({'prompt':f'The starting number is {n}. Advance by {k} numbers. The resulting number is','answer':' '+str(n+k)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
